summary: Notifications feature testing completed. Backend: 17/17 tests passed (100%). All notification creation triggers working (transfers, bill payments, card freeze/unfreeze, registration). All notification CRUD endpoints functional. Frontend: Code review confirms UI implementation is correct with notification bell, badge, navigation, and mark read functionality. Playwright automation encountered React Native web component interaction issues preventing full UI automation testing.

testing_limitations.workaround: Manual testing recommended or use React Native Testing Library instead of Playwright for RN components

playwright_automation_notes.issue: Playwright unable to interact with React Native TextInput components rendered in web preview
playwright_automation_notes.root_cause: React Native components render differently in web preview compared to native HTML elements. TextInput may not render as standard HTML input element.
playwright_automation_notes.recommendation: Use React Native Testing Library (@testing-library/react-native) for component testing instead of Playwright for React Native apps, or perform manual UI testing
